India Post GDS 4th Merit List Out gdsonlineengagement

India Post has released GDS 4th Merit List 2026 on the official website @indiapost.gov.in/gdsonlineengagement. The 3rd Merit List was published on 11 May 2026 while 2nd Merit List & 1st Merit List were released on 10 April 2026 & 6 March 2026 respectively. The recruitment drive is being conducted for 28,636 Gramin Dak Sevak (GDS) posts including BPM & ABPM vacancies. Selection is based on Class 10 marks and no written examination is held. Candidates can check state wise GDS 4th Merit List PDF & other important updates below.

How to Check Indian Post GDS 4th Merit List 2026?

Candidates can check India Post GDS 4th merit list 2026 online through the official portal. The merit list has been released in PDF Format for all postal circles. Candidates can follow the steps below to check 4th merit list.

  1. Visit the official website @indiapost.gov.in.
  2. Click on 4th Merit List.
  3. Select Postal Circle/State.
  4. Download the merit list PDF.
  5. Open the PDF and search registration number.
  6. If the registration number appears in the list then you are shortlisted for the next stage i.e., document verification and medical examination.

What Next After India Post GDS 4th Merit List 2026?

After the India Post GDS 4th Merit list 2026, shortlisted candidates will be called for document verification. Candidates must carry all requisite original documents. After DV medical examination will be conducted. Final selection will be confirmed only after both stages are successfully completed.
